questions.question: What is a HAR file?
questions.answer: An HTTP Archive (HAR) contains browser request metadata, timing, headers and potentially sensitive content.

questions.question: Does Mightora upload my HAR?
questions.answer: No. The analyser processes HAR files locally in the browser.

questions.question: Can it run offline?
questions.answer: Yes. Download a ZIP containing a standalone HTML file, then open the HTML in your browser.

questions.question: Can sanitised exports identify users?
questions.answer: Possibly. Hosts and some paths remain and should be reviewed.
